name: Rungrado 1st of May Stadium
scope: Standing Rungrado stadium, with its ring of sixteen roof lobes, outer facade and open bowl over the athletics track and soccer field.
era: Standing stadium after the 2014–2015 renovation. The cleared 2012 view identifies the retained roof and outer facade geometry. Renovation-era cladding and seating colors are approximate.

references.caption: View of Pyongyang from the Juche Tower. Taken with a Canon Powershot A590IS and stitched in Hugin.
references.alt: View of Pyongyang from the Juche Tower. Taken with a Canon Powershot A590IS and stitched in Hugin.

originalReview.notes: The standing stadium in 2012 seen across the Taedong River. The pale scalloped canopy, descending radial supports, recessed dark glazing and river relationship are clearly visible.

review.method: Exact Qualla CC0 panorama crop with parent release, mapped stadium and pitch, and eyewitness dimensions
review.notes: The exact Qualla CC0 crop and its parent panorama identify the same author release. The crop shows the white scalloped roof dropping to piers, pronounced blue-gray recession beneath the arches and open bowl. The eyewitness account confirms sixteen arches, a 60 metre apex and the renovation. The initial Terrarium tile contained severe outliers and the original GLO-30 field was frozen before authoring.
